name: 李傕

character.y: 李傕[jué]，字稚然。北地郡泥阳县人，汉末群雄之一。东汉末年汉献帝时的军阀、权臣，官至大司马、车骑将军、开府、领司隶校尉、假节。 李傕本为董卓部将，后被董卓的女婿牛辅派遣至中牟[mù]与朱儁[jùn]交战，大破朱儁，进而至陈留、颍川等地劫掠。
character.z: 技能存在方差，但极高的上限还是鼓励你在关键时刻搏一搏的。
character.x: 天下财富，####都将归我所有。

implementationInterpretations: Langxi requires both actual defined HP values, chooses a living other at HP <= owner, samples native replayable RNG Next(3) after the actual accepted target choice; zero produces no positive damage.

Yisuan captures an actual accepted native effective Trick Use and exact physical processing-to-discard exit, including all material entities only after all have exited. Generic discard cannot qualify. Nullification native accepted use is tracked separately.

Each actual Play phase has its own once quota. The frozen paid right survives source loss and drains native cost children before claiming still-available original discarded entities; a dead owner receives no new gain.

The optional cost spends one actual maximum HP, including 1 to 0. The terminal case enters real native ProgramSkill death return rather than a rescuable dying window or a minimum-one clamp. This is an implementation interpretation, not an official FAQ.

Nullification qualification follows its actual native ordering: accepted single use, later ordinary multi-material fact, or exact bound NamedAmbush deferred native receipt. Each physical entry and its native finish reason are proven; a scalar once-issued qualification is attached only to the final existing batch, never merged batches.
